docs.summary: Defines the extrusion mode for face extrusion operations.
Each vertex moves along its own normal, averaged across all selected faces sharing that vertex. Vertices are shared between extruded faces.
All vertices move along the average normal of all selected faces. Vertices are shared between extruded faces.
Each face gets its own copy of vertices and moves along its own normal. Faces joined by hidden edges count as one face and move together.
